transactions.name: First mainnet hide (15 STRK leg)
transactions.note: Real STRK shielded into the privacy pool through the app's own anonymizer. Fee paid from the visible balance.

transactions.name: Second mainnet hide (15 STRK leg)
transactions.note: Second tranche of the same plan. Landed SUCCEEDED on-chain even though the wallet UI misreported it as failed at the time, which drove the app's wallet-error reconciliation feature.

transactions.name: Largest single-leg mainnet hide (43 STRK)
transactions.note: Biggest single-leg hide to date, executed end-to-end through the app: analysis, tranche plan, wait-out-delay, wallet STRK20 relay.

contracts.name: RhizomeVesuAnonymizer (mainnet)
contracts.note: privacy_invoke helper for Vesu vault deposit and withdraw. Adapted from StarkWare's reference vesu_lending_anonymizer. Unaudited. Deployed on mainnet with --confirm; verify:facts checks this class hash against the class committed in artifacts/, so the reviewed bytecode and the deployed bytecode are provably the same.

contracts.name: RhizomeVesuAnonymizer (sepolia)
contracts.note: Same reviewed class as mainnet, deployed to sepolia for rehearsal. Unaudited.

contracts.name: STRK20 privacy pool (mainnet)
contracts.note: The STRK20 shielded-pool this app hides into. Read-only for the app: the app never holds keys or proofs; the wallet (Argent X) generates all zero-knowledge proofs.

contracts.name: STRK20 privacy pool (sepolia)
contracts.note: Rehearsal pool on sepolia, same STRK20 interface.
